hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH/phiETH swap curve by intercepting swaps in beforeSwap, taking the input token from the pool manager, converting via phiEth.deposit()/phiEth.withdraw(), and settling the output — fully bypassing concentrated liquidity. Liquidity additions are blocked; the pool supports only ETH/phiETH pairs with zero fee.
